exposure: Conventional methods for controlling postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 86 women who experienced postpartum hemorrhage with a volume of bleeding over 1000 mL during cesarean section between January 2008 and January 2012
finding: Patients treated with sterile normal saline ice blocks for postpartum hemorrhage during cesarean section had significantly less blood loss, lower transfusion volume, lower rates of hysterectomy and infection, and shorter hospital stays compared to conventional methods.
